name: Jonathan Marshall
summary: Software developer building full-stack applications with React, Flask, PostgreSQL, and the OpenAI API. Built Ask-Flask with streaming responses, persistent sessions, session-pinned memory, and a RAG prototype using embeddings, FAISS, and PII redaction. Delivered a paid client MVP with Stripe Checkout, verified webhooks, and idempotent fulfillment. Previously managed nuclear inspection projects and cross-functional teams of more than 40 engineers and technicians.

skills.label: Frontend
skills.items: React, Redux Toolkit, Vite, React Router, react-markdown, remark-gfm, PrismJS

skills.label: Backend & APIs
skills.items: Flask, REST APIs, SQLAlchemy (ORM/Core), Pydantic v2, Gunicorn

skills.label: AI/LLM & RAG
skills.items: OpenAI API (Chat Completions, embeddings), Server-Sent Events (SSE), prompt design, context management, session-pinned memory, chunking, PII redaction, FAISS, retrieval (MMR-style), simple evals/agent endpoints

skills.label: Security/Observability
skills.items: JWT (HTTP-only cookies), CSRF, CORS, security headers (CSP, HSTS, XFO, Referrer Policy), Flask-Limiter, structured JSON logs, request IDs, latency metrics, uniform JSON error envelopes

skills.label: Data/Cloud
skills.items: PostgreSQL, SQLite, AWS S3 (presigned URLs), Render

skills.label: Testing/CI
skills.items: Pytest, Vitest (React Testing Library), GitHub Actions, Postman

bullets: Built and deployed a paid client MVP on Render with React, Flask, and PostgreSQL, including a global 30-second message rotation synchronized across devices.
Integrated Stripe Checkout with promo codes, webhook signature verification, and idempotent fulfillment to handle retries without duplicate inserts.
Enforced a 30-message limit with deterministic FIFO eviction in the backend, including rotation and webhook fulfillment paths.
Led nuclear eddy current inspection projects from requirements through team coordination and data analysis, supporting reactor safety decisions.
Translated technical inspection findings into clear options, risks, and recommendations for nontechnical stakeholders.
Managed concurrent projects and cross-functional teams of more than 40 engineers and technicians, coordinating schedules, constraints, and quality standards.

projects.name: Ask-Flask
bullets: Built a React (Vite) + Flask AI chat app integrating the OpenAI API with token streaming via SSE and a non-stream JSON fallback endpoint.
Implemented persistent chat sessions and session-pinned memory, using summarization to maintain continuity while controlling context growth.

Built a RAG prototype with chunking, PII redaction, embeddings, FAISS, and MMR-style retrieval. Added rate limiting, security headers, structured logs, consistent errors, and Pytest/Vitest tests with coverage thresholds.

projects.name: Fantasy Football Research Hub
bullets: Built a full-stack app with React/Vite, Redux Toolkit, Flask-RESTful APIs, and PostgreSQL/SQLite via SQLAlchemy ORM.
Implemented JWT authentication with HTTP-only cookies and CSRF protection, plus server-side AWS S3 profile uploads and signed image retrieval.
